# Indigo Expedition

> > Indigo Expedition specializes in curated private and public group tours across Morocco and Spain, featuring Sahara Desert expeditions, Atlas Mountains treks, and immersive cultural adventures.

Indigo Expedition is a luxury travel and expedition planning company offering both pre-designed tour packages and custom itineraries for adventurers exploring North Africa. The company serves diverse audiences including students, groups, and premium travelers with comprehensive travel services including insurance, 24/7 support, and specialized themed expeditions.

## Key Topics

- Morocco travel
- Sahara Desert expeditions

- Group expeditions

- Casablanca
- Women's tours
